overview: A BMS is the safety layer that sits between raw lithium cells and the rest of a circuit, continuously watching voltage (and often current and temperature) to cut the connection if a cell gets overcharged, over-discharged, or short-circuited — the exact failure modes that make bare lithium cells dangerous. Single-cell BMS boards are simple pass/fail protection; multi-cell ones add balance wires, tapping each individual cell in a series pack so the BMS can equalize slightly-mismatched cells during charging, keeping the whole pack healthy over time rather than letting one weak cell degrade faster than the rest.
simpleSummary: A safety circuit that watches a battery and cuts power if it's being charged or drained dangerously.

specifications.cellCount: 1S (single cell) up to multi-cell series packs (2S, 3S, 4S...), each needing a matching BMS
specifications.protections: Overcharge, over-discharge, overcurrent/short-circuit, and often over-temperature
specifications.balancing: Multi-cell BMS boards include balance leads to equalize charge across series-connected cells
specifications.continuousCurrentRating: Varies widely by board, from a few amps to 100A+ for high-power packs

pinMap.name: B+
pinMap.function: Battery pack positive terminal (raw, unprotected side).

pinMap.name: P+
pinMap.function: Protected positive output, to the load/charger — passes through the protection MOSFETs.
pinMap.voltageRange: Matches pack voltage when not tripped
pinMap.gotcha: P+/P- (protected side) and B+/B- (raw cell side) are NOT the same nets — mixing them up bypasses the protection circuit entirely.

pinMap.name: Balance Leads
pinMap.function: On multi-cell boards, individual taps to each cell's junction point in the series stack, letting the BMS measure and balance each cell separately.
pinMap.gotcha: Must connect to the correct junction points in the correct order — a miswired balance lead can give the BMS a wildly wrong per-cell reading and disable protection for that cell.

useCases.title: Safe multi-cell robot battery pack
useCases.scenario: Protect and balance a series-connected pack of 18650 cells powering a robot.

useCases.title: Single-cell LiPo protection
useCases.scenario: Add basic overcharge/over-discharge protection to a bare single-cell LiPo not already protected internally.
